optimizedDescription.value: Defines shared single-pass template expansion, immutable built-ins, contextual namespaces, unknown handling, and dual shell dialects.

optimizedContext.value:
# Template Variables

## Rules
- Tokens use `{{namespace.key}}`, detected by `\{\{([^}]+)\}`. Namespace/key names match `[a-z0-9-]+`; dots separate path components. Only string, number, boolean values substitute.
- `TemplateVariables = Record<string, Record<string, string | number | boolean>>`; namespaces contain flat keys.
- Immutable built-in `project.root` is absolute directory containing `specd.yaml`, injected by composition and always present.
- Active change may supply `change.name`, absolute `change.path`; archived runtime may supply `change.archivedName` basename `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>`.
- `change.workspace` is forbidden, including `[0] ?? default` derivations; derive workspace sets from `specIds` outside templates.
- Future namespaces allowed; engine traverses supplied map without registry.
- Resolve namespace then key. Primitive → substituted value; missing/non-primitive → original token plus optional `onUnknown(token)` once per unresolved occurrence. Single pass; never rescan inserted values.
- `expand()` substitutes verbatim for instructions and developer-authored `run:` hooks. Developer controls quoting; multiple tokens inside one quote remain one string. `HookRunner` MUST NOT call `expandForShell()` for developer hooks.
- `expandForShell(template, variables?, dialect?)` serves commands SpecD builds. Default `posix`: single-quote escaping. `cmd`: empty → `""`; `%` → `%%`; `"` → `""`; wrap value in double quotes.
- `TemplateExpander` class:
  `constructor(builtins: TemplateVariables, onUnknown?: OnUnknownVariable)`
  `expand(template: string, variables?: TemplateVariables): string`
  `expandForShell(template: string, variables?: TemplateVariables, dialect?: posix | cmd): string`
- Composition constructs one expander with built-ins and optional logging callback. Use cases pass contextual maps per invocation; contextual values cannot override built-in keys. Methods share resolution logic, differ only substitution escaping.

## Constraints
- No recursive expansion.
- Unknown tokens preserved; callback informational, never halts.
- Flat values within namespaces; no nested objects.
- Shell escaping only via `expandForShell()`.
- `project` always present; other namespaces optional.
- Expander validates neither values nor path safety; injecting caller owns validation.
